title: Human heart
description: Choose a heart chamber and trace the path blood takes through that side of the heart.
learningObjectives: Explain the path blood takes through the left side of the heart
Sequence the chambers blood passes on its way out to the body

events.name: chamber_selected
events.description: The child chose a heart chamber.

events.name: path_traced
events.description: The page traced the blood path through the chosen chamber.

tutorGuide.intro: The heart is four rooms. Blood visits them in order. Tap the left ventricle to see the path out to the body.
steps: Read the path from the lungs, through the left atrium, into the left ventricle, and out to the body.
observationPrompts: Which chamber pumps blood out to the whole body?
Where does blood go just before it enters the left ventricle?

misconceptions.belief: The left side of the drawing is the person's left side.
misconceptions.response: You are looking at the heart from the front, so the person's left side is on your right.

misconceptions.belief: The heart puts oxygen into the blood.
misconceptions.response: The lungs add oxygen. The left side of the heart pumps that blood out to the body.

hints: The picture shows the heart from the front.
The left ventricle is on your right, and its label says it pumps blood to the body.

successCriteria.description: Chose the left ventricle and traced its blood path

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: Four labeled heart chambers. Choosing the left ventricle traces the path blood takes out to the body.
